item.title: Researchers Disclose AI-Assisted SharePoint Exploit Chain Reaching Unauthenticated RCE
item.summary: Security researchers found a way to enter Microsoft SharePoint servers as any user, including an administrator, with no valid account. A significant part of the work that found it was done through an AI agent.
